name: eslint-plugin-tailwind-a11y
description: ESLint rules that catch WCAG accessibility violations — color contrast, touch target size, and focus indicator removal — in Tailwind CSS class combinations.

scripts.prepublishOnly: node -e "if(require('./package.json').dependencies['tailwind-a11y'].startsWith('file:'))throw new Error('Refusing to publish with a file: dependency on tailwind-a11y')" && npm run build && npm test

author: chamroro
